name: Est Rinaudo
source:
A young prodigy who skipped a few grades due to his talent. A cold person with an amazing talent at casting spells. Always with a book, he's shy and distant at first, but later he warms up to Lulu.

[Edited from [url=http://wand-of-fortune.wikia.com/wiki/Est_Rinaudo]WOF Wikia[/url]]
